verdict.rationale: The only delegation evidence is a Patent Center note that sponsored support staff can prepare and save an AIR Form, which Corresponding Practitioners can then access. That shows a published role split between support staff and practitioners, but nothing broader about what a third party may or may not do. Missing for 10: published authorization or power-of-attorney forms, a full catalog of delegated roles and their permitted actions, which signatures must remain personal, and any trademark-side delegation rules or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal

citations.quote: Sponsored support staff will be able to prepare and save an AIR Form for submission. Corresponding Practitioners can access the saved submission
